changes.change: Read aloud can start, pause, resume and follow step navigation with the explanations hidden; showing them restores the current sentence’s visual cues.
Quickly moving or tabbing between inline hints closes the previous popover instead of leaving it stuck open.
changes.reason: Bug fix restoring existing hint hover/focus behavior; no authoring API or reader controls changed.

changes.change: Project architecture documents presentation shortcut routing, shared grouped help, temporary code-region emphasis and animated keyboard panel presets with author/manual size precedence.
changes.reason: Internal architecture update describing already documented presentation behavior; no runtime, public API or usage changes.

changes.change: Presentation-only panel shortcuts add collapse/restore (`1`), animated 35% / 50% / 75% presets (`2`–`4`), lower-panel/code maximization (`5` / `0`) and temporary region emphasis (`H`). Alt lists all active commands including narration, with persistent grouped help available from the hint or header. Help also lists Esc outside presentation and explains narration availability.
Optional `subtitle` frontmatter displays a smaller, muted line beneath the tutorial navigation title, with ellipsis for long text and space for the sibling selector on phones.
Hiding explanations after selecting text preserves the active step; hidden-panel scroll events no longer jump back to the introduction or first step.
changes.reason: Bug fix restoring the existing navigation behavior; no authoring API or reader controls changed.

changes.change: Public documentation review now fingerprints every top-level `docs/*.md` file and the root/package READMEs, reports affected paths and detects added or removed pages even without changelog citations. The initial usage audit corrects narration in presentation mode, intro outline/media fallback, request-only Result panes, series card links and README CLI/request-runner descriptions.
Project architecture summarizes the documentation review records, fingerprint checks, publication gates and website Markdown source links.
changes.reason: Internal architecture summary of the existing documentation release gate; no library usage or runtime behavior changes.

changes.change: Documentation review now covers every changelog entry from 0.2.0-beta.10 onward, with public section links or a specific no-docs reason, reviewed package/document fingerprints, and blocking checks in CI, website deployment and npm publication. The upgrade guide includes narration and pane-height usage notes; website docs link to their Markdown source.
changes.reason: Repository release safeguards and source links do not change the library API; the contributor workflow is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.

changes.change: Codex instructions require sequential validation commands when they rebuild the shared core package output, including site E2E web server builds.
changes.reason: Agent-only build sequencing instruction; no authoring API, runtime, CLI or installation behavior changed.

changes.change: Opening or resizing the lower pane reveals the active code region after the code viewport changes; regions that fit stay fully visible, and taller regions show their start.
Console object trees no longer draw a native list bullet over the preceding log label.

`<Step panelHeight={30}>` and `<Intro panelHeight={30}>` set Preview / Console / Result to a percentage of the right column height (15–85), without overwriting the reader's saved size. Readers can still resize; compact phones and maximized panes keep their full-screen behavior.

Live Console has a dedicated Features section, light/dark screenshots captured from a real Preview interaction, a screenshot scene that regenerates them without credentials, a landing page highlight, and links to the authoring reference and migration guide. Available since 0.2.0-beta.10.

Console entries show a source file and line when available; inlined scripts and substituted modules preserve source names and cleaned-code line numbers. Collapsed summaries now color keys and scalar types like DevTools. A collapsible help explains selecting the Preview iframe context in browser DevTools and filtering to that context.

Embedded Preview / Console tabs capture real `console.log/info/warn/error` calls as bounded, in-memory snapshots with labeled entries, severity, collapsible colored JSON trees and compact property previews. Tabs, collapse and maximize preserve the running iframe and its logs; Run resets the log. Capture works in dev and static builds, without adding code to the tutorial app.
Desktop and phone pane-height screenshots reviewed and approved before publication.
changes.reason: Records visual approval of existing pane-height behavior; no additional library behavior is introduced.

changes.change: Project architecture documents the optional Console capture pipeline, message handling, the `view` / `collapsed` state flow, and author-controlled pane heights with shared splitter state and code visibility after resizing.
changes.reason: Internal architecture documentation of the already documented panel and console behavior; no separate public API change.

changes.change: Console is opt-in with frontmatter `console: true` (default false). Preview-only tutorials show no tabs and do not install console capture. The authoring reference and Features explain the separate tutorial setting and step actions.
With Console enabled, the embedded web pane is headed "Output", with "Preview" and "Console" as its tabs; the heading stays consistent when collapsed or selected by a step.

Console snapshot and DevTools guidance now share one collapsible footer below the scrolling messages, labeled "Live output · Objects captured at log time · DevTools" The help clarifies that messages are live and objects preserve their values when logged; selecting a step does not run code. The separate toolbar and manual Clear button have been removed.

**Breaking authoring change:** `<Step>` and `<Intro>` now use `view="preview|console|result"` to select and open the lower pane, and `collapsed` to fold it. Omitted keeps the reader's state. This replaces their `preview="expanded|collapsed|keep"` prop and the unreleased `panel` prop; `collapsed={false}` opens without changing views; `maximize="preview"` becomes `maximize="panel"`. Frontmatter `preview` is unchanged. Validation includes migration guidance; examples, fixtures and authoring/upgrade docs use the new API.
